name: Taira no Kiyomori
source:
The Seiryu of Earth from the realm of Ōka.

Leader of Taira clan. 25 years old
An ambitious man who raised his status as a samurai in a society centered of nobles.
Graceful, friendly and quick-witted.
However, His true intention remains hidden, making him feared by his political opponent.

Character Designer: Kurage-han (Special Thanks : Miniwa)

[Translated from [url=http://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/characters/chara02_tairanokiyomori..html]official website[/url]]
